entities.name: Teodósio de Gouveia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Theodósio Clemente de Gouveia GCC GCIH was a Portuguese Cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church, who served as Archbishop of Lourenço Marques in Mozambique from 1940 until his death, and was elevated to the cardinalate in 1946 by Pope Pius XII.
